prompt:
The woman of the first reference picture, in her late fifties, with exactly
her face and her hair tied back in a bun, stands on the grey granite pavement
of the street shown in the second reference picture, in the morning sun. She
wears a light navy coat, open over a white blouse.

She is seen from the hips up, a little right of centre in a vertical frame. The
bottom edge of the picture crosses her coat at the hips, and the top of her
head sits a hand's width under the top edge, so that her face is one of the
largest things in the picture.

On the left of the picture, beside her hip, the top of her shopping trolley
just rises above the bottom edge: the rim of its red and dark-green tartan
bag, where four oranges sit beside a long baguette and the green tops of two
leeks, and its black handle rising to the height of her waist. Her hand nearer
to it holds that handle. Her face is turned three-quarters towards the camera
and her eyes look towards the left edge of the picture, where someone stands
beyond the frame, with a curious, kindly look, her eyebrows slightly raised. Behind her, out of focus, the ochre facades and wrought-iron balconies
of the street run on to the right; the sun comes from the right of the picture.
